## 站点简介 (Brand Summary)
AURORABEAT is an independent musical instrument maker specialising in steel tongue drums, handpans, kalimbas and wind chimes. Our in-house team handles material selection, alloy preparation, tuning and quality control, and we ship to musicians and distributors in over 60 countries. OEM/ODM, private label and small-batch programs are available.

## 核心卖点 (Selling Points)

- In-house material development team crafting each instrument from raw alloy
- Standardised tuning programme with dedicated professional tuners
- Direct-from-factory pricing for musicians and wholesale partners
- Worldwide shipping with secure export packaging
- Full OEM/ODM support including custom logo, colour and tuning

## 目标市场 (Target Markets)

- Europe
- North America
- Japan and South Korea
- Southeast Asia
- Australia and New Zealand
- Middle East

## 认证资质 (Certifications)

- Standardised production base with documented quality control process
- Full OEM/ODM manufacturing capability
- Export packaging compliant with international freight standards

## 服务能力 (Service Capabilities)

- OEM/ODM with custom logo, colour and tuning
- MOQ from 1 piece for ready models; negotiated for custom builds
- Sample orders and small trial orders accepted
- Lead time typically 15 to 30 days depending on model and quantity
- Neutral or branded packaging, multi-layer corrugated export cartons
- Accessory kits and joint bags available

## 常见问题 (FAQ)

- Q: Are you a factory or a trading company?
- Q: Can you make instruments with our own logo and tuning?
- Q: What is the minimum order quantity?
- Q: What is the lead time?
- Q: Do you ship worldwide?
- Q: How do you control tuning quality?
